answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 47810 Country: India Title: Islamic Name Question: My brother had a beautiful daughter this month in Shawwal, he is thinking of naming her Mehreen is it a good name? If not, please suggest any other better names. Answer ID: 47810 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1498/H-1113/TH=11/1434) Mehreen is a correct name, you may keep it. However, it would be far better if you choose any name from the following: Ruqayya, Zainab, Umm Kulsum, Barirah, Tayyabah, Umm Habibah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
